setup: Android 12 emulator, two signed Release builds. Mount eight marquees, remove all, then mount all eight again. Instrument registration and removal in the same native primitive used by AOT and DevRuntime.
instrumentation:
from pathlib import Path
import sys
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
for unit in (root/'Generated/android/app/src/main/java').rglob('*.kt'):
    text=unit.read_text()
    if 'ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE' not in text: continue
    lines=text.splitlines()
    out=[]
    for line in lines:
        out.append(line)
        if 'resolver.registerContentObserver(' in line:
            out.append('        android.util.Log.i("NexaMarqueeBench", "register animation")')
        if 'resolver.unregisterContentObserver(observer)' in line and 'onDispose' not in line:
            out.append('            android.util.Log.i("NexaMarqueeBench", "unregister animation")')
        if 'onDispose { resolver.unregisterContentObserver(observer) }' in line:
            out[-1]=line.replace('observer) }','observer); android.util.Log.i("NexaMarqueeBench", "unregister animation") }')
    unit.write_text('\n'.join(out)+'\n')
    assert text!=unit.read_text()
    break
else:
    raise RuntimeError("native observer not found")
